selectionSensorText: Parameters, selected probes, ranges, accuracy conditions, sampling and reporting requirements.
selectionInstallText: Station location, sensor exposure, mounting, power budget, cable routing and service access.
selectionSystemText: Selected communication version, compatible receiving path, platform mapping, alert recipients and commissioning checks.
integrationHeading:
Field observations.
Connected to your operation.
integrationIntro: Bring selected measurement records into Hitelecom Cloud or a compatible customer platform. Define the sensors, communication version and platform workflow in the same project plan.
cloudText: View uploaded monitoring data online and receive alerts when measurements exceed configured thresholds. Configure the monitoring points, limits and notification recipients around the site's operating procedures.
cloudBullet1: Online access to uploaded monitoring data
cloudBullet2: Configured threshold alarms and notification workflow
cloudBullet3: Agreed sampling, reporting and response requirements
customerText: Agree the platform connection and data mapping for the selected communication version. Confirm MQTT configuration where used; a LoRa deployment also needs a compatible receiving gateway and integration path.
handoverText: Verify a known sensor reading at the receiving platform, then test a configured threshold event and its notification recipient. Record the actual radio and backhaul conditions as part of the handover.
faqIntro: Practical answers for channel selection, sensor installation, power, communication and platform integration.

enquiryBenefitsText: A site plan, parameter list and sampling or reporting requirements give the project a useful starting point. Add the power conditions, installation country and receiving platform.
